note: Set A contains no claims at all, so it captures none of the spanwise quantities plotted in Figure 2-4. Set B correctly binds chord, twist, prebend, relative thickness and pitch-axis chord location to the blade with the right r/R conditions and units, and gets the root chord (~5 m) and root twist (~15 deg) right. However, B misreads several endpoints: relative thickness is 100% at the root and ~21% at the tip (not 21% and 15%), pitch-axis chord location is 50% at the root and ~37% at the tip (not 25% at both), prebend at the tip is about -4 m (sign lost), and tip chord/twist are ~1.5 m and ~-1.5 deg rather than 1 m and 0 deg. Despite these errors, B's correct extractions and full coverage of the plotted quantities outweigh A's empty output.
